description: This file defines an interface for serializing BusinessEvent objects into Avro format, specifying methods for serialization compatibility, schema support, and conversion to an Avro-compatible DTO.

classes.name: BusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: An interface for serializing BusinessEvent objects into Avro format, providing methods to check serialization capability, get the supported schema, and convert events into Avro DTOs.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the serializer can serialize the given BusinessEvent.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the specific Avro schema class supported by this serializer.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent into an Avro-compatible ByteBufferSerializable DTO.
